messages:
ava: Heads-up — opened a docs PR for the v1->v2 migration guide that needs cross-SDK examples (py/go/rust) and a short smoke-test section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :wave:
liam: thanks, can you paste the minimal migration snippet here? i can port to go.
sophia: quick note — v2 changed the `invoke` params shape and embedding call name; we need to highlight that in the overview paragraph so users don't miss it.
ava: snippet below (Python). it's intentionally tiny — please preserve the example's single-sync flow for the smoke test:
ava: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.responses.create(model="redwood-v2", input="Summarize this")
print(resp.output_text)
```
rio: porting now. small Q: should Go example use the sync client or streaming? my vote: sync for migration guide, streaming in a separate doc.
ben: +1 sync. also we need a one-liner CLI command for CI smoke tests. propose: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"ok"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses | jq .`
liam: i pushed a Go translation to the PR branch, pls proofread. i used the official SDK v2 func name `CreateResponse` to show the rename.
sophia: small editorial: add an explicit callout that model alias `redwood-embed-v1` -> `redwood-embed-v2` has different vector dims; callers must re-index vectors. put that under "breaking changes".
ava: good catch. i'll add an inline note and link to the embeddings migration checklist.
docs-bot: link-checker found a dead link in the PR (line 84). Suggested fix: update `/guides/embeddings/` -> `/guides/embeddings/migration/`.
ben: i fixed the curl example to use JSON and escaped quotes in the PR. also included an exit code check for CI.
ava: can someone own the rust snippet? it's the one area we don't have coverage for.
rio: i can mock up the Rust snippet tomorrow morning. tagging @liam to review for accuracy.
liam: ack. will review rust sample and the smoke-test ci step.
deploy-bot: staging docs deploy queued for 10:05 UTC after PR merge.
sophia: before merging: add a short warning about hardbreaking webhooks behavior — old v1 headers are removed. i can add the copy.
ava: assigning reviewers: @liam, @sophia, @ben. aiming to merge today if no blockers. :thumbsup:
ben: minor lint nits fixed. added a one-liner `NOTE:` under the top-level migration checklist.
ava: final ask — can QA run the curl smoke test against staging after deploy? if green we merge.
liam: will run CI smoke tests and report back.
ava: thanks all — if anyone finds additional SDK edgecases (timeouts, default timeouts changed), drop them as comments.
